# Philips N4520 Player v0.0.19

## Changes

- Fixes Sendspin VU frames being scheduled many seconds in the future when Music Assistant publishes far-ahead audio timestamps.
- Uses `chunk.serverTimeUs` for stable VU frame spacing while anchoring the VU timeline to local receipt time plus `sendspin_vu_offset_ms`.
- Keeps earliest queued VU frames when the queue is capped, instead of discarding the frames closest to playback.
- Expands the Sendspin VU queue limit to tolerate deeper Music Assistant buffering.
- Adds raw absolute Sendspin lead (`abs`) to `sendspin_debug` output.

## Notes

With `sendspin_debug: true`, the expected timing source is now `timeline/sync`.
The `lead` value is the local anchored VU lead. The `abs` value is the raw
Sendspin absolute lead, which may be much larger and is no longer used directly
for meter display timing.
